entry.title: New: dsh-fish-tts
entry.summary: Reads assistant replies aloud via Fish Audio API only (bring your own key): per-message read-aloud, auto-read toggle, and a settings page for model, voice reference_id, encrypted API key, and proxy. Exact install spec: github:mari23333/dsh-fish-tts. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
